name: COMMA
description: COMMA is a benchmark designed to evaluate the collaborative performance of multimodal multi-agent systems through language communication. It features a variety of scenarios testing agent-agent and agent-human collaborations across four key categories of agentic capability in communicative collaboration settings.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for multimodal multi-agent collaboration that is emerging in the research community but has not yet seen broad long-term adoption.
notes: Focuses on agent-agent and agent-human collaboration with multimodal multi-agent systems; reveals weaknesses in state-of-the-art models including GPT-4o.
